title: Choose Kotoba's visual world (round 3)
question: A new hand with the stamp sheet leading. If none of these fit, type in Steer what's missing (for example: more Japanese, calmer, more playful, more professional).

options.label: Tờ tem Bưu điện
options.lineage: Vietnamese postage stamp sheets: perforated rows of engraved stamps, cancelled with a round postmark
options.thesis: The kana chart as a sheet of 46 stamps. Each one you master gets a real postmark.
options.viewport: A full sheet of hiragana stamps on a deep green album page, each stamp with its romaji value in the corner. A red postmark reads KOTOBA · HÀ NỘI next to the headline and a 'Học thử ngay' button.
options.risk: Philately can feel old-fashioned or fussy if the engraving detail crowds the characters.

raised.raise: Each postmark carries the actual date you mastered that kana.
Selecting a stamp lifts it off the sheet and dims the other 45.
The next quiz card is visible, tilted behind the current one, before it's dealt.
The perforation grid is one strict repeat that re-tiles cleanly at any width.
'Reset progress' sits alone, well away from the other actions.

options.label: Màn hình Karaoke
options.lineage: Vietnamese karaoke lyric screens: colour-wipe lyrics over a video background
options.thesis: Karaoke is Japanese and Vietnamese at the same time. Read kana the way you sing: the color wipes across the syllables.
options.viewport: A lyric line こんにちは wiping from white to cyan syllable by syllable with the Vietnamese reading underneath, a song number menu, and a 'Hát thử' (try it) button.
options.risk: Karaoke is a strong, familiar reference and can turn into kitsch.

options.label: Memory Quilt Atlas
options.case: Loses both: textile provenance has nothing to do with learning a script.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.case: Loses both: needs painted assets we don't have, and reads as Ghibli pastiche.
options.kept: Interactive elements live on their own plane.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.case: Loses both: a tool look for beginners.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.case: Loses both: no connection to the audience.

options.label: Particle Event Display
options.kept: Selection isolates and dims the rest.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A friendly language-learning app landing page: mascot, green buttons, streaks.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, mascot illustration, and 'Bắt đầu' / 'Tôi đã có tài khoản' buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other language app.
